AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
July 24, 2013
07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

1.
Use Permit No. UP-2013-04 & Design Review No. DR-2013-19 Location: 680 E. Alosta Avenue
APN: 8612-001-057
Applicant: Delta Groups Engineering Inc. forVerizon Wireless.
A request for approval of a Use Permit and Design Review approval to allow the construction and operation of a stealth, roof-mounted telecommunication facility located on an existing commercial building within the University District-Mixed Use (DU-MU) zone. The application also includes the installation of ancillary equipment related to the operation of the proposed telecommunication facility. This project is exempt under the California Environmental Quality Act, Section 15301(e).

2.
Use Permit No. UP-2013-03 & Design Review DR 2013-16 (Telecommunication Facility) Location: 402 E. Sierra Madre Avenue
Applicant: Crown Castle NG West, Inc.
A request for approval of a Use Permit and Design Review to allow the construction and use of an individual distributed antenna system (DAS) antenna on an existing wood utility pole, located in the public right-of-way at 402 E. Sierra Madre Ave., in the Specific Plan #6 (Rosedale) zone. The application also includes the installation of ground-mounted ancillary equipment related for the operation of the proposed facility. This project is exempt under the California Environmental Quality Act, Section 15301 Existing Facilities.
